budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Lemieux reported total projected FY24 revenues and their split by source: property tax, State Aid, local receipts and other available funds.
budget_items.quote: projected revenues totaling $47,321,389 for fy24 include: $31,422,519 in property tax (66%), $10, 500,128 in state aid (22%), $3,160,153 in local receipts (7%), and $2,238,588 in other available funds (5%).

budget_items.topic: Property tax levy and new growth
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY2024 target budget adds 2 ½ percent to the prior year's levy and includes $200,000 for New Growth.
budget_items.quote: the fy2024 target budget includes revenues for property taxes included adding 2 ½ percent to the previous year's levy

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State Aid is level funded at the FY23 figures approved in July of the prior year; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: state aid was level funded based on fy23 state aid figures approved in july of last year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Local receipts include a $50,000 increase over last year's estimate for Motor Vehicle Excise; other receipts are level funded.
budget_items.quote: local receipts included a $50,000 increase over last fiscal year's estimate for motor vehicle excise tax

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY24 will use stabilization funds to offset an 8.5 percent increase in health insurance and a 5 percent retiree rate increase.
budget_items.quote: fy24 will use stabilization funds to offset the 8.5 percent increase in health insurance, as well as a 5 percent rate increase for retirees.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expenditures include an additional $50,000 for pavement management.
budget_items.quote: expenditures also include an additional $50,000 for pavement management

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expenditures include a 13.55 percent increase for Worcester County Retirement.
budget_items.quote: a 13.55 percent increase for worcester county retirement

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expenditures include a 2.5 percent increase for Lunenburg Public Schools and Monty Tech.
budget_items.quote: a 2.5 percent increase for lunenburg public schools and monty tech

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expenditures include a 5 percent increase for general insurances for the police and fire departments.
budget_items.quote: a 5 percent increase for general insurances for the police and fire departments

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unknown Overlay Account expenditures (abatements) will affect how certified free cash is spent for FY24; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: unknown expenditures for the overlay account, which covers abatements, will affect how certified free cash is spent for fy24.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Speakers said waterfront property values rose 77 percent on average and that a resident faces a 135 percent increase in taxes; the figures are as stated by speakers, not verified by the minutes.
